figures.finding: A resident pays 5% on the first NIS 75,000 of taxable income, 10% on the next 75,000 and 15% above, after a standard deduction of NIS 36,000 a year; only Palestinian-source income is taxed.
figures.applies: Palestinian residents (Palestinians present 120 days, others 183), calendar year 2026.

sources.said: The first NIS 75,000 is taxed at 5%, the next NIS 75,000 at 10%, and the remainder at 15%.
Individual income is reduced by a standard deduction of NIS 36,000 per year.
Palestinian residents and nonresidents are taxed only on Palestinian-source income.

figures.finding: The tax year is the calendar year; the self-employed file within four months of year end (by 30 April 2027); employment income is withheld by the employer.

sources.said: Tax year: The tax year is the calendar year.

Tax on employment income is withheld by the employer and remitted to the tax authorities. Self- employed individuals and employed individuals with income from other sources must file a self-assessment return within four months following the end of the tax year.

figures.finding: The employer withholds income tax on pay; payments for goods and services bear 5% to 10% withholding unless the payee shows a tax certificate.

sources.said: Tax on employment income is withheld by the employer and remitted to the tax authorities.
Other: Payments for goods and services are subject to withholding tax at rates ranging from 5% to 10%, unless the payee provides a tax certificate issued by the tax department.

figures.finding: No compulsory social security contribution is collected: the new social security law is on hold by presidential decision.

sources.said: The president has put on hold implementation of a new social security law introducing compulsory monthly social security contributions for all Palestinian private sector employers and employees

figures.finding: A non-resident's fee for services provided bears a 10% withholding, as do royalties paid to non-residents.

sources.said: Payments made for services provided by a nonresident are subject to a 10% withholding tax unless the rate is reduced or an exemption is available under an applicable tax treaty.
A 10% withholding tax is imposed on royalties paid to a nonresident unless the rate is reduced or an exemption is available under an applicable tax treaty.

figures.finding: Every business and individual registers for VAT, with no threshold; the standard rate is 16%.

sources.said: Registration: All business entities and individuals must register for VAT purposes; there is no minimum threshold.

sources.title: Palestinian Territories Highlights 2026 (Deloitte International Tax)
sources.said: The first NIS 75,000 is taxed at 5%, the next NIS 75,000 at 10%, and the remainder at 15%. … Individual income is reduced by a standard deduction of NIS 36,000 per year. … Palestinian residents and nonresidents are taxed only on Palestinian-source income. … Tax year: The tax year is the calendar year. … Tax on employment income is withheld by the employer and remitted to the tax authorities. Self- employed individuals and employed individuals with income from other sources must file a self-assessment return within four months following the end of the tax year. … Other: Payments for goods and services are subject to withholding tax at rates ranging from 5% to 10%, unless the payee provides a tax certificate issued by the tax department. … The president has put on hold implementation of a new social security law introducing compulsory monthly social security contributions for all Palestinian private sector employers and employees … Payments made for services provided by a nonresident are subject to a 10% withholding tax unless the rate is reduced or an exemption is available under an applicable tax treaty. … A 10% withholding tax is imposed on royalties paid to a nonresident unless the rate is reduced or an exemption is available under an applicable tax treaty. … The standard VAT rate is 16%. … Registration: All business entities and individuals must register for VAT purposes; there is no minimum threshold.
